acceptanceCriteria: Changing one shared Outcome query default or enum changes actual CLI parsing, MCP schema, and generated three-language reference facts without separately editing those facts.
CLI and MCP retain their current transport-specific names and deliveryProgress remains MCP-only.
The discovery operation remains deterministic, read-only, and starts no verification subprocess.
The change does not alter Outcome lifecycle, authorization, or delivery behavior.
A finish-ready Work Item whose source snapshot changes after a commit may record a fresh preflight and replacement verification; archive remains blocked until that replacement evidence is current.
authority: explicit user authorization to continue the existing interface SSOT remediation and record required confirmations
goal: Make the actual Outcome query parameter definitions the single source for shared CLI/MCP interface facts, while preserving lifecycle and authorization behavior.
intent: Eliminate remaining manual duplication between the work-item outcome executable parser, CLI/MCP interface description, and generated reference facts.
sources: user-conversation: approved continuation of the proposed minimal interface SSOT design
